user.title: Wrist Assistant
user.description:
This turns on Wrist Assistant. Next, open **Wrist Assistant** in the sidebar and choose **Pair a device** on the Home tab. With the iPhone app, choose **Show a QR code**. On a watch without an iPhone, choose **Pair with Home Assistant** on the watch, then type the code it shows under **Type a code**.

[Setup guide]({docs_url})

abort.single_instance_allowed: Wrist Assistant is already set up. To add a device, open Wrist Assistant in the sidebar and choose Pair a device.
